about: I am a researcher and creative technologist pursuing an MRes in Creative Computing at the University of the Arts London. My work sits at the intersection of AI and creative practice — multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, automatic drum transcription, and authorship in AI art. It builds on a quantitative foundation: a BSc in Mathematics (UBC) and an MSc in Operational Research with Data Science (Edinburgh), plus hands-on machine learning and data work in industry.

Yet my creative journey truly began in 2016, when I wrote my first poem and discovered an unparalleled sense of fulfillment. Despite following a path in science and engineering, I have never lost my love for the creative arts. Today, I continue to work across photography, poetry, and design alongside my research in AI and creative technology.
